content: We have introduced the task of predicting annotation difficulty for biomedical information extraction (IE). We trained neural models using different learned representations to score texts in terms of their difficulty. Results from all models were strong with Pearson’s correlation coefficients higher than 0.45 in almost all evaluations, indicating the feasibility of this task. An ensemble model combining universal and task specific feature sentence vectors yielded the best results.
